caso.texto:
A fictional team logged 100 scheduled meetings, 60 held and 30 meeting quality criteria within the same set. The manager rewards only scheduling and some records are duplicates. Four reps have different portfolios and complexity. Forecasts treat every proposal as guaranteed revenue.

A US sales manager coordinates remote account executives and an SDR team across time zones. Compare eligible cohorts and workloads before ranking individuals. Procurement reviews create dependencies outside the rep's direct control.

projeto.instrucoes: Fix definitions, calculate attendance and quality, propose one-skill coaching and a 30-day plan with hypothesis, measure and review condition.
projeto.gabarito: Before deduplication, stated-set attendance is 60%, quality among held meetings 50%, and quality among bookings 30%. Recalculate after correction. Add quality to incentives, preserve forecast uncertainty and avoid assuming the target caused every issue.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
